status: real Linux container image built and checked headless on a Lima/Ubuntu VM; service SIGTERM shutdown fixed to exit 0

environment.host: macOS 27.2.1 arm64 Mac mini; no native Linux and no container engine before provisioning
environment.display: none (no X11/Wayland; DISPLAY and WAYLAND_DISPLAY unset)
environment.provisioning: lima docker template; repo mounted read-only at the same absolute path

image.build: docker build with host proxy build args

fix.symptom: docker stop made the service exit 143 because uvicorn restores the previous handler and re-raises the captured SIGTERM after graceful shutdown; the container check requires exit 0
fix.change: serve_instance keeps its own SIGTERM/SIGINT handler that sets should_exit, so the re-raised signal is absorbed and the process exits 0
fix.validation: container check passed (fresh+reopened), affected offline tests 57 passed in 12.53s

gaps: no X11 session: G3 X11/AT-SPI control identity, XRes/frontmost postcondition and user-intervention guards remain unverified
no Wayland session: G4 RemoteDesktop/EIS authoritative window association, pause and revocation remain unverified
no graphical fixture, lock screen, sleep or hotplug in the VM
container check is headless/no-desktop only: full_suite_run=false, whole_v2_accepted=false
limits: VM is ephemeral and lives outside the repo; image and check artifacts are recorded, not committed as binaries
Ubuntu 26.04 is newer than the documented Linux targets; distro-specific behavior may differ on 22.04/24.04
graphical-session gaps remain blocked until a real X11/Wayland environment is available
